favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.intro: A favorite holds a world's game version, Space Age setting, map settings, server settings without passwords, mods and mod settings. Start a new world from one on Generate.
favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Open a world and use "Make favorite" on its page.
favorites.deleted: Deleted the favorite "{name}". Worlds made from it are unchanged.
favorites.delete.question: Delete the favorite "{name}"?
favorites.delete.removes: Remove the favorite and its settings files for good. No snapshot is taken.
favorites.delete.keeps: Leave every world made from it, and the world it was made from, as they are.
favorites.make.heading: Make a favorite from this world
favorites.make.text: Saves this world's game version, Space Age setting, map settings, server settings without passwords, mods and mod settings, to start new worlds from. The world itself is not changed.
favorites.make.default_map: This world has no map settings, so worlds made from the favorite get the default map.
favorites.make.label: Favorite name
favorites.made.default_map: It has no map settings, so worlds made from it get the default map.

favorites.made.left_out.one: {count} mod is left out because Foreman cannot download it again: it is a folder mod, or its name or version cannot be read. Add it to new worlds by hand.
favorites.made.left_out.other: {count} mods are left out because Foreman cannot download them again: each is a folder mod, or its name or version cannot be read. Add them to new worlds by hand.

favorites.error.name_empty: Enter a name for the favorite.

favorites.error.name_bad.one: Use at most {count} character, with no control characters.
favorites.error.name_bad.other: Use at most {count} characters, with no control characters.

favorites.error.name_taken: Another favorite already has this name. Choose a different name.
favorites.error.settings_broken: This world's server settings are not valid JSON, so no favorite was made. Fix them on the Game settings tab first.
favorites.error.too_big: This world has too many mods or settings to save as a favorite.
favorites.error.gone: That favorite no longer exists or its files are damaged. Choose another favorite, or generate without one.
favorites.start.heading: Start from a favorite
favorites.start.label: Favorite
favorites.start.none: No favorites yet. Make one from a world's page.
favorites.start.note: Starting from the favorite "{name}". Its game version, Space Age setting, preset and map settings are filled in below; change anything you like. The new world gets its server settings and mod settings.
favorites.review.generated: Generated {name} from the favorite. Below are the favorite's mods to install on it.
favorites.review.unsupported_version: The favorite was saved on game version {version}, which this Foreman does not support, so its mods cannot be installed from it. Go back to the Mods tab to install the newest versions instead.

favorites.start.mods.one: After the world is made, you review {count} mod to install.
favorites.start.mods.other: After the world is made, you review {count} mods to install.

favorites.error.map_damaged: This favorite's map settings are damaged, so Foreman cannot fill them in. Choose another favorite, or delete this one and make it again from a world.
favorites.export.warning: Export downloads a favorite as a file to share or move to another Foreman. It includes the mod settings, and a mod may keep a token or other private value there, so share it only with people you trust.
favorites.import.heading: Import a favorite
favorites.import.text: Add a favorite from a file another Foreman exported. Mods this Foreman lacks are still imported, and Generate's mod review shows them. A game version this Foreman does not support is replaced by the default version on Generate.
favorites.import.label: Favorite file
favorites.import.bad: This is not a favorite file Foreman can read, or it is damaged. Nothing was imported.
favorites.import.name_taken: A favorite with this file's name already exists. Rename or delete that favorite, then import again.
